samples.title: A report from the demonstration issuer
samples.description: Signed by the demonstration issuer, whose key is in the demonstration trust list. It shows what an accepted report looks like.

samples.title: A report signed by a key nobody enrolled
samples.description: Signed with a different throwaway key that is not in the demonstration trust list. It shows that a valid signature alone does not make a signer trusted.

samples.title: A report changed after it was signed
samples.description: The trusted report with one field changed after it was signed. It shows how a changed report is caught.

samples.title: A report that says it was computed on plaintext
samples.description: The report states that no encryption was used. It shows the wording for a plaintext report.

samples.title: A report that names an encrypted backend
samples.description: The report names an encrypted backend, but nothing was encrypted: the file only says so. It shows that the portal cannot verify such a statement.
